Siegeworks siege engines

Siegeworks replaces Siege Machines and uses Axiomata construction blueprints. Axiomata and Recruits 1.15.2 are included. Open the target recipe in JEI and prepare the materials for each

Culverin, serpentine and Mons Meg blueprints use canonical Overgeared steel instead of iron. Forge gun barrels on the Overgeared metal anvil from eight TFC-heated steel ingots. The blueprint lists exact stage quantities.

The Siegeworks arquebus uses the existing gunsmith matchlock. Flintlock and researched-blueprint routes remain available in the gunsmith JEI category. Gunpowder follows the shared modpack route using TFC sulfur and
Overgeared smithing hammers and TFC hammers also work as construction tools. Farmer’s Delight rope is accepted as blueprint material alongside Axiomata rope. Follow the blueprint stage sequence.

Projectiles cannot break claimed Towny blocks, including when fired by the owner. Protection covers direct impacts, explosions, ignition and debris extraction/landing. Claims are checked when the action happens, including claims created after
If Towny is unavailable, these block changes are denied until checks recover. Normal Siegeworks rules apply in wilderness. Operator permissions do not bypass claimed-block protection.
